caption: Zuidertoren, Schiermonnikoog
composition: White tower with a copper dome in the dunes · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Zuidertoren is the white tower in the dunes at the edge of the village. It was built in 1853-1854 as the inner light and was converted to a water tower around 1950, so the glass lantern is gone and a copper dome with a small monk finial closes the top. The light is not burning. It is overcast, about 15.5°C, with wind near 6.8 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The tower is not open at this hour. The red Noordertoren is another scene and is not in this frame.
